subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold this behavior into broader `openclaw models status --probe --all` work, or defer it to staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the permanent command contract overlaps existing auth probes and open model diagnostics or migration requests, so automation should not choose the product surface alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused slash and/or CLI fallback-chain probe with an optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Let broader configured-model health-check work own this behavior and make `/models` a discoverability wrapper only if maintainers want that UX.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Treat fallback testing as one step in staged model migration and avoid a standalone command until that broader flow is scoped.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused slash and/or CLI fallback-chain probe with an optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the clearest public scoping guidance and has direct history on the overlapping model-status probe surface.
